# Codex setup check

This is a read-only connectivity check for the workshop's GitHub Actions setup.
Follow the repository instructions. Do not start any requirements, development,
refactoring, or finalisation workflow.

Read `package.json`, `AGENTS.md`, and `docs/codex-github-actions.md` in this
checkout. Return a brief English report with:

- The application name and framework found in the source.
- Confirmation that Codex received this prompt and could read the checkout.
- The five planned workflow phases listed in the setup guide.
- A reminder that this run does not verify application behavior or the future
  issue/PR automation.

Do not modify files, install dependencies, run builds or tests, start services,
make network requests, or perform GitHub writes. Do not read environment variables,
credential files, or personal configuration. Do not print secrets or reproduce
personal skill contents. Report missing files honestly instead of inventing their
contents.
